## sections/<name> or snippets/<name>

What this section, block, or snippet renders, in two sentences.

**Theme files:** path under `sections/`, `blocks/`, `snippets/`, or `assets/`.

### Mechanism

Which Liquid file, `{% schema %}` setting, or asset script owns the behaviour. Grep setting ids and metafield keys before citing them.

### Out of scope

What a neighbouring section or a sibling app owns (link that README or the INDEX slug).

Optional tracker links go last. Never as the only content.
